description: This file defines an Android activity named PresentationActivity that demonstrates how to display content on secondary displays using the Presentation API. It manages multiple presentations on connected displays, allowing users to select displays, view information, and display images with customized backgrounds. The class handles display enumeration, user interactions, and presentation lifecycle management.

classes.name: PresentationActivity
classes.description: Main activity managing the display of presentations on secondary displays, handling user interactions, display list updates, and presentation lifecycle.

classes.name: DemoPresentation
classes.description: Inner class extending Presentation, representing the content shown on a secondary display, including image and background customization.

classes.name: DemoPresentationContents
classes.description: Parcelable class storing information about the content to display, such as selected photo, colors, and display mode.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, restores state, sets up display manager, UI components, and display list.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Updates display list, restores previous presentations, and registers display listener.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Unregisters display listener and dismisses all active presentations, saving their state.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves presentation content state for activity restoration.

methods.name: showPresentation
methods.description: Creates and shows a presentation on the specified display with given content.

methods.name: hidePresentation
methods.description: Dismisses the presentation on a specified display.

methods.name: setPresentationDisplayMode
methods.description: Sets display mode for an active presentation.

methods.name: getNextPhoto
methods.description: Cycles through available photos to display.

methods.name: onCheckedChanged
methods.description: Handles toggle of showing all displays or individual presentations.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles click events, such as showing display info.

methods.name: onItemSelected
methods.description: Handles selection of display modes for a display.

methods.name: onNothingSelected
methods.description: Handles deselection of display modes, resetting to default.
